done_when: Review findings of the Test kind whose case is only a future change to a test fake or call order are advice and do not block close; tests select gh calls through one shared helper by path or query instead of by position or count; the two flaky tests no longer fail at random under load; new and existing repos get the review rule on upgrade
why: Review findings about how a test could miss a future change (a fake that matches exact request text, a gh call counted by position) block close and cost a round each, and tests that select gh calls by position or count break each time a command adds a GitHub request (4 times on 18 Nov 2026); two tests fail at random on busy runners (the machine memory budget test and test_3_worker_reruns_report_only_the_final_result)
